verdict.rationale: Datalab offers on-prem/air-gapped Enterprise deployment, BAA/DPA on Team plan (implying HIPAA-relevant compliance), and 2FA security controls, which support regulated document processing. However, there is no explicit mention of SOC 2 certification or a documented zero-retention data policy for uploaded documents. missing for 10: explicit SOC 2 certification evidence, explicit zero-retention/data-deletion policy statement, and independent audit confirmation of HIPAA/SOC 2 compliance claims.
